figures.Fig12.3: Figure 12.3 Synthesis of ammonia gas (PDF page 275). Original figure archived as c11-chem-ch12-fig-ammonia-lab (drawn for this lesson after the printed figure; not the textbook's picture). The printed figure tilts the boiling tube with its closed (heated) end low and its mouth raised; drawn with the mouth sloping slightly down (correct practice, so that condensed water cannot run back onto the hot glass).

findings: The original diagram tilts the test tube's mouth slightly down, the usual practice so that water formed cannot run back onto the hot glass; the printed drawing tilts it up. Quicklime (CaO) is named as the drying agent shown in the tower.
Figure 12.3 as printed raises the mouth of the heated boiling tube; the redrawn figure slopes the mouth slightly down and the Roman Urdu lesson explains why.
